question: What is the sound-mass in one reflection nature?
premises: In one reflection nature, sound-mass is Bhairava.
By reflection-shadow and union, that same power is mother-power.
inference: Bhairava as sound-mass manifests mother-power through reflection-shadow.
plain_english: In one reflection nature, sound-mass is Bhairava; by reflection-shadow and union, that same power is mother-power.
